title: U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program allows attackers with valid local application…
description: The U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program contains a vulnerability that allows attackers with valid local application credentials to bypass the intended Keycloak authentication flow by sending JSON POST requests to the login endpoint without a Referrer header. This flaw enables establishing an application session improperly. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 8.1 and was fixed around October 19, 2026.
